CustomField.description: True when this relationship is a legitimate marketing/communication target: the Role(s) are not limited to Invoice and/or Digital (pure-invoicing contacts are excluded), and the Contact has at least one of Email, Phone, or Mobile Phone populated.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT( AND( OR(INCLUDES(Roles, "Invoice"), INCLUDES(Roles, "Digital")), NOT(INCLUDES(Roles, "Main")), NOT(INCLUDES(Roles, "Payment")), NOT(INCLUDES(Roles, "Reminder")), NOT(INCLUDES(Roles, "Shipping")), NOT(INCLUDES(Roles, "Sales")), NOT(INCLUDES(Roles, "Service")), NOT(INCLUDES(Roles, "ASR")) ) ), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Contact.Email)), NOT(ISBLANK(Contact.Phone)), NOT(ISBLANK(Contact.MobilePhone)) ) )
CustomField.label: Marketing
